title: Organic and content
hired_for: To turn free posts, creators and community into sales, without the founder having to make every post.

jobs.job: Show which posts and products actually sold, not just which got views
jobs.why: Views feel like progress but do not pay wages. Without a link or code on each post, the team keeps making what gets views instead of what sells.

watch.metric: revenue from orders with a post's tracked link or content-only code, 30 day
watch.source: Shopify orders joined to GA4 UTM tags and discount codes

drives.metric: share of total revenue from organic social

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 0% of posts carry a tracked link, so organic sales read unavailable. After: every post is tagged and 4 posts show $6,200 in sales this month.

jobs.job: Answer comments and messages fast with a real next step
jobs.why: A buyer asking 'does this come in size 12' is ready to buy now. A reply the next day often loses the sale and looks careless in public.

watch.metric: median time to first reply on comments and messages that need one, 7 day
watch.source: Meta Business Suite inbox and TikTok inbox

drives.metric: orders from social message threads

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: median reply is 19 hours. After: 2 inbox checks a day and saved answers bring it under 2 hours.

jobs.job: Post what we planned, every week
jobs.why: Reach comes from showing up. A floor the team can hold beats bursts and silence, and a missed week costs the next month's reach.

watch.metric: posts published versus the planned weekly floor, weekly
watch.source: Instagram and TikTok insights against the content calendar in the brand brain

drives.metric: views from people who do not follow us, 30 day

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 6 of 12 planned posts went out last week. After: batch filming days hold 12 of 12 for 4 straight weeks.

jobs.job: Fix posts that send buyers to a dead, sold-out or wrong page
jobs.why: A post that works but links to a 404, a sold-out product or the home page wastes the one moment the buyer was ready.

watch.metric: share of live posts whose link works, matches the product and is in stock, weekly
watch.source: link check of live posts against Shopify product and stock status

drives.metric: add-to-cart rate from social visits

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 9 of 40 live posts point to a page that is gone or sold out. After: all 40 point to a live, matching page.

jobs.job: Cover the next holiday or sale with a script and stock ready
jobs.why: Holiday posts need to be filmed weeks early. A missed slot means the brand is silent when buyers are most ready to spend.

watch.metric: holiday and sale slots in the next 30 days that have a finished script
watch.source: content calendar in the brand brain

drives.metric: revenue from tagged content in the holiday window

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: Black Friday is 21 days out with no script. After: 5 of 5 slots scripted, and the hero product has stock for the push.

jobs.job: Feed posts that already sell into paid ads
jobs.why: A post that sells to strangers for free is a tested ad. Running it as paid content is often cheaper than a new studio shoot.

watch.metric: cost per purchase of promoted organic posts versus studio ads, 30 day
watch.source: Meta Ads Manager

drives.metric: blended cost per new customer

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: no organic post has been run as an ad. After: 3 top posts run as ads at $31 per purchase versus $44 for studio ads.

jobs.job: Make the first 3 seconds of each video hold people
jobs.why: Most viewers decide in the first seconds. A weak opening means the platform stops showing the post to new people.

watch.metric: share of viewers still watching at 3 seconds, and average watch time, 7 day
watch.source: Instagram and TikTok insights

drives.metric: views from people who do not follow us

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 28% of viewers stay past 3 seconds. After: product-first openings on 10 videos lift it to 40%.

jobs.job: Make every post name a product and give a next step
jobs.why: Posts with no named product and no next step can reach many people and sell nothing. Strangers need to know what it is and where to get it.

watch.metric: share of posts that name a product and give a next step, 30 day
watch.source: post tags in the content calendar

drives.metric: clicks from posts to product pages

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 4 of the top 10 posts by reach named no product. After: every post names one product and a next step.

jobs.job: Get creator and customer content with rights to use it in ads
jobs.why: Without written rights, the best creator video cannot run as an ad or on the product page. Getting rights later costs more.

watch.metric: share of creator and customer content received with written usage rights, per month
watch.source: creator seeding tracker in the brand brain

drives.metric: cost per usable ad creative

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 3 of 20 creator videos have rights. After: rights are in every seeding agreement, 18 of 20.

jobs.job: Tag products in posts so viewers can buy in one tap
jobs.why: Every extra step between a post and the product loses buyers. Product tags cut the path to one tap.

watch.metric: share of eligible posts with a correct product tag, 30 day
watch.source: Instagram Shopping and TikTok Shop

drives.metric: orders from product tag clicks

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 35% of eligible posts are tagged. After: 95% tagged and product tag orders double.

jobs.job: Reuse good reviews and customer photos before they go stale
jobs.why: Verified reviews and customer photos are the most believable content a brand has. Left unused, they age out.

watch.metric: share of verified reviews and customer photos reused in a post or page within 60 days
watch.source: reviews app and the content library in the brand brain

drives.metric: product page conversion rate where reused

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 140 photo reviews unused for over 60 days. After: 2 review posts a week, 30 used this month.

jobs.job: Keep every post's claims true and legal
jobs.why: One unproven health or comparison claim, or an undisclosed paid post, can bring a platform strike, an FTC letter or a refund wave.

watch.metric: posts held or changed at the claims check, and platform removals, 30 day
watch.source: claims check log in the brand brain and platform notices

drives.metric: platform strikes and takedowns

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: posts go out with no check. After: every post passes a claims check, 3 held this month, 0 removals.

jobs.job: Grow the email and SMS list from social reach
jobs.why: Followers belong to the platform. An email or phone number is a buyer you can reach for free next month.

watch.metric: new email and SMS sign-ups from social visits and comment-keyword messages, 30 day
watch.source: Klaviyo sign-up source and GA4

drives.metric: revenue from email and SMS flows

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 80 sign-ups a month from social. After: a comment keyword that sends a fit guide by message brings 400.

jobs.job: Seed creators who send back content and sales
jobs.why: Free product to creators is a real cost. Many never post. Track who delivers so the budget goes to people who do.

watch.metric: content pieces delivered per 10 creators seeded, and product cost per usable piece, 30 day
watch.source: creator seeding tracker in the brand brain

drives.metric: revenue from creator codes and links

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 40 creators seeded, 9 posted. After: seeding only creators who match the buyer lifts it to 6 of 10.

jobs.job: Reach new people who can buy, not just followers
jobs.why: If most views come from followers, the account is talking to itself. New buyers come from people who have never heard of the brand.

watch.metric: share of views from people who do not follow us, 30 day
watch.source: Instagram and TikTok insights

drives.metric: new visitors from social

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 78% of views come from followers. After: stranger-first posts bring non-follower views to 55%.

jobs.job: Put the time on the one platform where buyers spend time
jobs.why: Posting everywhere spreads a small team thin. One hero platform with the others as free extra reach gets more sales per hour.

watch.metric: tagged revenue and non-follower views by platform, 90 day
watch.source: Instagram, TikTok and YouTube insights with Shopify tagged orders

drives.metric: revenue per hour of team time on content

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 4 platforms get equal time and TikTok brings 70% of tagged sales. After: TikTok is the hero and the rest get reposts.

jobs.job: Keep a bank of post ideas, each naming a product
jobs.why: A team that starts from zero every week misses the floor. A bank of ready ideas keeps posts going when things get busy.

watch.metric: ideas in the bank that name a product, in weeks of posting runway
watch.source: content calendar in the brand brain

drives.metric: posts published versus the planned floor

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 3 ideas left. After: 40 ideas covering 8 weeks, drawn from buyer questions in comments.

jobs.job: Film in batches so posts are 2 weeks ahead
jobs.why: Filming the day you post means the floor breaks the first busy week. Batching keeps a buffer.

watch.metric: finished posts waiting in the queue, in days of buffer
watch.source: content calendar in the brand brain

drives.metric: posts published versus the planned floor

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 0 days of buffer. After: 1 filming day every 2 weeks keeps 14 days ready.

jobs.job: Turn a post that worked into a series the team can repeat
jobs.why: A one-off hit fades. A named format that keeps working gives the team a proven recipe and less guesswork.

watch.metric: average views and tagged sales per post in the series versus the account average, 8 weeks
watch.source: Instagram and TikTok insights with Shopify tagged orders

drives.metric: revenue from tagged content

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 1 'sock drawer' video beat the average 5x. After: 8 episodes average 2.5x views and 3x tagged sales.

jobs.job: Make sure every product gets posted about
jobs.why: When the same 2 products get all the posts, the rest of the catalog sits and ages. Rotation finds new winners.

watch.metric: share of active products featured in a post in the last 30 days
watch.source: post tags in the content calendar and Shopify product list

drives.metric: sales of products outside the top 5

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 6 of 40 products featured. After: 20 of 40 in a month, 2 new products start selling from posts.

jobs.job: Answer the questions buyers keep asking, as posts
jobs.why: The same questions about size, care and returns show up in comments again and again. A post that answers them removes doubt before the buy.

watch.metric: repeat pre-purchase questions in comments, 30 day (proxy: tagged comments)
watch.source: Meta Business Suite and TikTok comments

drives.metric: conversion rate of visits from social

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 60 'what size do I get' comments a month. After: a pinned fit video cuts it to 20.

jobs.job: Build a bench so the founder is not on camera for every post
jobs.why: If every good post needs the founder, content stops when the founder is busy. A small team or creator bench keeps it going.

watch.metric: share of posts that need the founder on camera, 30 day
watch.source: post tags in the content calendar

drives.metric: posts published versus the planned floor

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 80% of posts need the founder. After: 2 team members and 3 creators on a rotation bring it to 40%.

jobs.job: Decide if the community is worth the time
jobs.why: A group or Discord takes hours to run. It is worth it only if active members buy more often than other customers.

watch.metric: active members in 30 days, and share of members who ordered in the last 90 days
watch.source: community platform export matched to Shopify orders

drives.metric: repeat rate of members versus non-members

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 3,000 members, activity unknown. After: 12% active, members repeat at 2x, so the group keeps its weekly hour.

jobs.job: Get found in YouTube search with videos that sell
jobs.why: YouTube videos keep getting found through search for years. Titles and chapters that match what buyers search bring steady views.

watch.metric: share of YouTube views from YouTube search, 90 day
watch.source: YouTube Studio

drives.metric: revenue from YouTube tagged links

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 12% of views from search. After: retitled buyer-question videos lift it to 30%.
